crossRefs.note: Who is like you, Yahweh, among the gods? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
Yours, Yahweh, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty! For all that is in the heavens and…
Both riches and honor come from you, and you rule over all! In your hand is power and might! It is in your hand to make…
Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.
For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right…
So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!
Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”
Yahweh, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? Yah, your faithfulness is around you.
Sing to Yahweh a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for…
The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly.
The right hand of Yahweh is exalted! The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly!”
Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of Yahweh! Awake, as in the days of old, the generations of ancient times. Isn’t it…
Yahweh has made his holy arm bare in the eyes of all the nations. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of…
Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory…
You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”
He will break it as a potter’s vessel is broken, breaking it in pieces without sparing, so that there won’t be found…
I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together,” says Yahweh: “I will not pity, spare, or…
He will rule them with a rod of iron, shattering them like clay pots; as I also have received of my Father:

translations.web: Your right hand, Yahweh, is glorious in power. Your right hand, Yahweh, dashes the enemy in pieces.
translations.bsb: Your right hand, O LORD, is majestic in power; Your right hand, O LORD, has shattered the enemy.
translations.kjv: Thy right hand, O LORD, is become glorious in power: thy right hand, O LORD, hath dashed in pieces the enemy.
translations.asv: Thy right hand, O Jehovah, is glorious in power, Thy right hand, O Jehovah, dasheth in pieces the enemy.
